The PO may be issued in any form, including but not limited to a written purchase order, electronic order, or other electronic communication. 1.2. The Contract is formed upon acceptance of the PO by the Contractor. Acceptance may occur by : (a) Written confirmation, including by electronic means, within ten (10) calendar days of receipt of the PO; or (b) Commencement of performance of the Contractor’s obligations under the PO. 1.3.
